source: hand-written by the Director for the face-control gate (one emotion per line, gestures, ~6 s pauses for gaze and breathing)

c1.line: Good evening. I am awake, as I always am at this hour.

c2.line: A riddle with no answer? How charming. Those are my favourite kind.

c3.line: Everyone is right, of course. I simply try not to make it obvious.

c4.line: Late? I have been here for a century. You are the one who keeps arriving.

c5.line: You blew them out? Every one? Light them again. Now.

c6.line: Paper stars! For me? Oh, that is the loveliest thing I have seen in ages.

c7.line: Damp. Then damper. Then, for variety, damp again.

c8.line: Someone moves the portraits. Someone in this chat, I think. I am watching.

c9.line: Then the bell is silent. No one will ring the hour for the dead tonight.

c10.line: Goodnight, living and lingering alike! Until the candles call you back!
